card.name: First digit of a two-digit count
card.fires_on: The first digit (often 1, 2 or 3) of a number written in digits that counts people or things, such as study subjects or schools. The number's second digit comes next.

modes.label: Study subject counts
modes.description: First digit of the number of healthy subjects or patients in a drug study.

modes.label: General counts
modes.description: First digit of a count of schools, students or economies in web text, or a spelled-out number before 'dozen'.
